text: Hi Sarah — I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. My week is quite full, so I can only offer these free half-hours: Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. Which of these works for you? If you'd rather have a full hour, let me know what you have free and I'll see what I can do. — Prof. Alvarez

Hi Prof. Alvarez — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me: it fits right before my CSE455 office hours at 15:30, so I'll come straight from the meeting. I've put the CSE455 staff meeting on my calendar for Tue 15:00-15:30. A full hour isn't needed on my side; if you'd prefer one, my free slots next week are Mon 09:50-11:00, Tue 11:10-12:10 (lunch) and Wed 12:00-13:00 — but half an hour on Tuesday suits me fine. — Sarah
Tuesday 15:00-15:30 it is — booked on my calendar too. Half an hour is fine. See you then. — Prof. Alvarez
